name: gate-mutation-stryker
description: Stryker and vitest for gate/mutation, installed by the job from this lockfile outside the PR's package tree. The job points the PR's node_modules/vitest at this vitest, so the PR's overrides and lockfile cannot change vitest, its runner plugin or anything they load. Versions are the ones the repo locks; Stryker core imports typescript to rewrite tsconfig.json in its sandbox.
